Java ME runtime in Olddays

Mozilla PluotSorbet source: https://github.com/mozilla/pluotsorbet
Commit: 46ee3e78a4fd9c3f09026cc5cbdcf76e94b7a398
VM JavaScript: Apache-2.0 (see source headers and LICENSE-VM.txt).
Java MIDP/CLDC library: GPL-2.0-only (see LICENSE-GPL-2.txt and per-file headers).
Native ASM/Relooper binary provenance: openGiraffes/pluotsorbet-kaios-template, commit 4c463b4fe160919bfb7228041debaa0f1a32a340. Its original LICENSE and native sources are included in runtime-sources.tar.gz.
Other original copyright/license notices are retained in component sources.

Olddays changes: compiler compatibility for Java 1.3, enum identifier rename, TypeScript build config, main script concatenation strict-mode fix, local in-memory JAR loading, restricted offline host bridge, modern input wrapper and museum layout. The bridge does not provide contacts, camera, real SMS, location, or remote sockets. Historical game data, where present in classic-games/, is separate from this runtime and retains its original copyright; it is not licensed under the runtime licenses.

Corresponding runtime sources and build inputs are available in runtime-sources.tar.gz beside this notice. This archive covers this runtime component, not the private Olddays application. Demo Java sources and GPL-2.0 license are in demos/sources.zip.
